standard_prerequisites.name: The lower shriek described on presheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Describes the sheaf associated to the presheaf obtained by adding the morphisms into the localizing object.

core_obligations: Computation (proof lines 5473-5483): the companion description identifies the value at an object as a disjoint union, over the morphisms into the localizing object, of the morphisms into the representing object compatible with the projection, and this disjoint union is exactly the set of morphisms into the representing object.
proof_roadmap: Apply the companion description of the lower shriek on presheaves.
Identify the resulting disjoint union with the morphism set of the representing object.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the lower shriek of the sheaf represented by an object of the localized site: it is the sheaf represented by the same object viewed in the ambient site (statement lines 5464-5470). The proof is a short complete computation: the companion description of the lower shriek gives the value at an object as a disjoint union over morphisms into the localizing object of compatible morphisms into the representing object, which is precisely the set of morphisms into that object (proof lines 5473-5483). The non-formal content is the identification of the disjoint union with a morphism set. The claim is H1: a one-step computation.
